mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates and increases equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is the current level of FEDFUNDS, which is always active.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An annualized CPIAUCSL inflation rate above 2.5% increases equity risk premiums and reduces valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL annualized inflation rate > 2.5% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate is below 5.0% and housing starts exceed 600.0 thousand, labor market tightness and strong housing demand signal economic expansion, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 5.0% AND HOUST > 600.0 and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising for 3 consecutive months), a high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 8.0%) signals a lagging labor market that is likely to recover, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening cycles, UNRATE > 8.0% and 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Low housing starts (HOUST < 500.0 thousand) indicate weak consumer demand and economic slowdown, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST < 500.0 and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Low industrial production (INDPRO < 90.0) indicates a weakening economy and reduced corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 90.0 and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction of high inflation (CPIAUCSL annualized inflation rate > 2.5%) and low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) creates a stagflationary environment that increases equity risk and reduces valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL annualized inflation rate > 2.5% AND FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 8.0%) indicates a weak labor market and economic slowdown, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is the current level of UNRATE, which is always active.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 8.0% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
